abilities.name: Locust Strain
abilities.description: Spawns a Locust to attack down the nearest lane every 15 seconds. Locusts last for 16 seconds, have 350 Health and deal 46 damage with each Basic Attack. Locusts deal 25% bonus damage to enemy Structures. Locust ; 15; trait

fields.notes: Damage bonus to Structures stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Locusts' Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Symbiote
abilities.description: Spawn and attach a Symbiote to a target ally or Structure. While active, Abathur controls the Symbiote, gaining access to new Abilities. The Symbiote is able to gain XP from nearby enemy deaths.

fields.notes: Allied and enemy Symbiote hosts display a crown icon above their portraits on the Minimap. Symbiote will be paused if the allied target enters a Stasis effect. Symbiote can still be canceled in these situations, but no Symbiote Abilities can be used.

abilities.name: Symbiote - Stab

abilities.name: Symbiote - Carapace
abilities.description: Shields the assisted ally for 150. Allied Heroes are healed for 22 Health per second while the Shield is active. Lasts for 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Healing ends immediately if Shield is destroyed.

abilities.name: Toxic Nest
abilities.description: Spawn a mine that becomes active after a short time. Deals 153 damage and reveals the enemy for 4 seconds. Lasts 90 seconds. Toxic Nest Toxic Nest Explosion

fields.notes: After the arming period Toxic Nest becomes invisible, grants vision around it and is capable of exploding. Invulnerable targets do not affect any Toxic Nests they walk over.

abilities.name: Ultimate Evolution
abilities.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability. Ultimate Evolution Clone ; 70; heroic

fields.notes: Ultimate Evolution Clone is untalented and does not inherit any progress on baseline quests. It is possible to complete baseline quests on the Clone, but any progress and rewards are reset for the next cast. Clone does not gain Ability effects that are unlocked by reaching a certain level, such as Muradin's Storm Bolt pierce. Clone can Mount, use the Healing Fountain and can benefit from, but not directly collect, Regeneration Globes. The Clone can fake channeling Objectives, but it cannot complete the channel to capture the Objective. Some of the Clone's Summons, including Lunara's Wisps, and Nova's Holo Decoys do not expire when the Clone expires or is destroyed. However, Misha and Samuro's Images, Probius Pylons, and Junkrat Mines and Traps exceptionally do expire. There are some limitations and exceptions to cloning certain Heroes: - Deathwing cannot be cloned due to his Trait. - Cloning Cho'gall only grants access to Cho's Abilities. - Cloning a Viking only clones the specific Viking targeted. - D.Va's clone can only use the form she was cloned from. Pilot D.Va's Call Mech is disabled, and activating Self-Destruct in Mech mode immediately returns control to Abathur, leaving the exploding Mech on the Battleground. Additionally, if Ultimate Evolution expires during this time, the Mech will instantly explode as it does. - Kharazim's level 1 Talent is inherited, as it is his Trait, with Insight completed if that Talent was selected. - Murky's Trait, Spawn Egg, is disabled. - Alexstrasza's and Ragnaros's Traits start on full cooldown every time they are copied, making it impossible to use Molten Core and Dragonqueen during the clone's lifetime. - The effects of Jaina's Frostbite, Malthael's Reaper's Mark, Murky's Slime, Sylvanas's Banshee's Curse, Tassadar's Psionic Storm, and Zagara's Creep Tumor do not stack and are instead shared, benefiting both the clone and the cloned Hero regardless of who applied the effect. - Qhira and her Clone can both apply their own instance of Bleed from Blood Rage. However, only the unit who placed the first Bleed stack on the unit may activate Blood Rage on it. Additionally, the stack count and duration are shared among all Bleeds on the target, allowing both Qhira and Abathur to instantly gain the current stack count on the target and increment and extend each other's Bleed stacks on the target. Bleeds placed by the Clone also remain even after when the Clone has expired. - Both Probius and his Ultimate Evolution Clone can fully interact with each other's Pylons and Warp Rifts. - On death effects that change a Heroes state, such as the traits of Uther, Tyrael, and Leoric, are not inherited by the Clone. Other post-death events, such as Junkrat's Total Mayhem, are inherited. The Clone grants no XP or Takedown credit on death. The Clone's Summons do not benefit from this Ability's Spell Power bonus. Attack Damage and Spell Power bonuses stack additively with offensive damage modifiers and healing dealt modifiers.

abilities.name: Evolve Monstrosity
abilities.description: Turn an allied Minion or Locust into a Monstrosity. When enemy Minions near the Monstrosity die, it gains 2% Health and 2% Basic Attack damage, stacking up to 40 times. The Monstrosity can be healed by Carapace and has the ability to Burrow to a visible location every 80 seconds. Using Symbiote on the Monstrosity allows Abathur to control it, in addition to Symbiote's normal benefits. This Ability can be reactivated to automatically cast Symbiote on his Monstrosity. Monstrosity ; 90; heroic

fields.notes: Monstrosity can use Deep Tunnel on an 80 second cooldown. This cooldown is separate from Abathur's. Monstrosity can heal in the Hall of Storms. Damage bonus from Minion kills stacks additively with itself and multiplicatively with offensive damage modifiers that can affect Monstrosity 's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Deep Tunnel
abilities.description: Quickly tunnel to a visible location.

fields.notes: Deep Tunnel can be canceled by issuing a "move" or "stop" command. Deep Tunnel goes on a 10 second cooldown when interrupted by enemy or allied Abilities, including self-canceling. Deep Tunnel has an allied chat announcement upon activation.
